notes: K6b slot K6B-S4 (b3): W1-T1 to W1-T4 on the release binary 20b67776... from 4eeb206c0 (the parity fix), after KF1 (main 0f5d8c7b4). The runner labels each row with its tier's planned slot; all four tiers ran together in slot K6B-S4.

W1-T4 (10,000 members) is pre-KF3. KF3 makes an unformable Uc unavailable instead of an attempt stop and records partial stage work on every error path; W1-T4 is re-run after KF3 merges, as a records addendum. ROOT's W1 limits use the post-KF3 figures.
Observation only: no time or memory bound is asserted. Times carry their recorded load.
